hero.body: One calm, connected place for attendance, parent communication, billing and safety across your centre.

hero.caring: Built for early childhood centres in the UAE

dashboard.subtitle: Here is a quick view of your centre.

guardians.confirmRemove: Remove this guardian from the student?

users.title: User accounts
users.subtitle: People who can sign in to your centre.

form.createDescription: Give a team member or parent access. They can sign in straight away with the password you set.
